mapper.select: SELECT MEM_LOGIN_ID, MEM_NAME, MEM_PASS, MEM_NICK, MEM_EMAIL, MEM_PHONE, MEM_ADDR, MEM_STATUS FROM MEMBER WHERE MEM_STATUS = 'N'

SELECT MEM_LOGIN_ID, MEM_NAME, MEM_PASS, MEM_NICK, MEM_EMAIL, MEM_PHONE, MEM_ADDR, MEM_STATUS FROM MEMBER WHERE MEM_LOGIN_ID = #{memLoginId} OR MEM_NICK = #{memNick} OR MEM_PHONE = #{memPhone} OR MEM_EMAIL = #{memEmail}

SELECT MEM_LOGIN_ID, MEM_NAME, MEM_PASS, MEM_NICK, MEM_EMAIL, MEM_PHONE, MEM_ADDR, MEM_STATUS FROM MEMBER
AND MEM_STATUS = 'N'
OR MEM_LOGIN_ID LIKE '%' || #{memLoginId} || '%'
OR MEM_NAME LIKE '%' || #{memName} || '%'
OR MEM_NICK LIKE '%' || #{memNick} || '%'
OR MEM_PASS LIKE '%' || #{memPass} || '%'
OR MEM_EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{memEmail} || '%'
OR MEM_PHONE LIKE '%' || #{memPhone} || '%'
OR MEM_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{memAddr} || '%'
mapper.insert:
SELECT 'mem_no_' || MEMBER_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO MEMBER ( MEM_ID, MEM_LOGIN_ID, MEM_NAME, MEM_PASS, MEM_NICK, MEM_EMAIL, MEM_PHONE, MEM_ADDR ) VALUES ( #{memId}, #{memLoginId}, #{memName}, #{memPass}, #{memNick}, #{memEmail}, #{memPhone}, #{memAddr} )
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET MEM_NAME = #{memName}, MEM_PASS = #{memPass}, MEM_NICK = #{memNick}, MEM_EMAIL = #{memEmail}, MEM_PHONE = #{memPhone}, MEM_ADDR = #{memAddr}, MEM_STATUS = #{memStatus} WHERE MEM_LOGIN_ID = #{memLoginId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_members, COUNT(CASE WHEN MEM_STATUS = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS active_members, COUNT(CASE WHEN MEM_STATUS = 'N' THEN 1 END) AS inactive_members, COUNT( CASE WHEN TRUNC(MEM_SIGNUP_DATE, 'IW') = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ) AS weekly_signups FROM MEMBER
